title: Hello World
intro: Today you teach the computer to TALK — your very first magic word!

steps.title: Meet print — the computer's voice
steps.text: print is a magic word that makes the computer say things on the screen. You type print, then ( ), and inside the ( ) you put words in quotes.

steps.title: Your turn! Make it say YOUR words
steps.text: Change the words inside the quotes and press Run. The computer will say whatever you put between the " " marks.
steps.funFact: The " " marks are called quotes — they tell the computer 'these are words, not magic commands!'

steps.title: Two things at once
steps.text: You can put lots of things inside print, separated by commas. The computer puts a space between them!

steps.title: Make art with print
steps.text: You can even draw pictures with print! Every line becomes a line on the screen.
steps.funFact: This is called ASCII art — pictures made only of keyboard letters!

mission.brief: Make the robot say Hello!

title: Name Boxes
intro: Today you teach the computer to REMEMBER things in little boxes!

steps.title: First — remember print?
steps.text: Last week you taught the computer to TALK with print! Press Run and hear it say hello again.

steps.title: Ready for something new?
steps.text: Super! Now today we learn how to make the computer REMEMBER things — in magic boxes with names on them!

steps.title: What is a variable?
steps.text: A variable is a box with a name on it. You put something inside — a word or a number — and the computer remembers it for later.

steps.title: Making a word box
steps.text: Type name = "Ava" to make a box called name with the word Ava inside. Then print(name) OPENS the box!
steps.funFact: No quotes around 'name' when you print it — that would print the word 'name', not what's inside!

steps.title: Number boxes (no quotes!)
steps.text: Numbers don't need quotes. Try age = 5 — no " " marks. The computer knows 5 is a number.
steps.visual:
age = 5       ← no quotes for numbers
name = "Ava"  ← quotes for words

steps.title: Two boxes together
steps.text: Make a hero and a power box, then print them in the same sentence. You can use as many boxes as you like!

steps.title: Change a box!
steps.text: You can put something NEW in the box any time. The old thing gets replaced.
steps.funFact: When you put something new in the box, the old one is gone forever — like clearing a toy chest!

mission.brief: Make a box called hero AND a box called power, then print them.

title: Joining Words
intro: Today you stick words together to make funny sentences and birthday cards!

steps.title: Remember boxes?
steps.text: Last week you made BOXES! Remember putting your name inside? Press Run and watch!

steps.title: Now — stick words together!
steps.text: Wonderful! Today we learn two magic signs that STICK words together to make bigger sentences.

steps.title: The + sign glues words
steps.text: The + sign sticks two words into one. It does NOT add a space — you have to put the space yourself inside the quotes.

steps.title: Glue a word AND a box
steps.text: You can glue a word to the stuff inside a box. Super handy for greeting people!

steps.title: Comma adds a space for you
steps.text: If you use a COMMA instead of +, the computer puts a space between them for you. Easier!

steps.title: Repeat with *
steps.text: The * sign REPEATS a word that many times! Great for silly stuff.
steps.funFact: This works with emojis too! Try print("⭐" * 10)

steps.title: Make a birthday card
steps.text: Put it all together — a birthday card for someone you love!

mission.brief: Join your name with Hello using +

title: Making Choices
intro: Today the computer learns to make CHOICES — like a little brain of its own!

steps.title: Remember + and comma?
steps.text: Last week you joined words with + and commas! Remember? Press Run.

steps.title: Now — teach the computer to CHOOSE
steps.text: Perfect! Today the computer learns to make choices by itself. Like a little brain!

steps.title: What is if?
steps.text: if is a magic word that CHECKS something. If the check is true, the computer does what's inside. If not — it skips it!
steps.visual:
if it's raining: take an umbrella
if you're hungry: eat a snack

steps.title: if in Python
steps.text: Watch this! Change score to 2 and run again — see what happens?
steps.funFact: The > sign means "bigger than". So 10 > 5 is TRUE. But 2 > 5 is FALSE.

steps.title: The 4-space secret
steps.text: Did you spot the 4 spaces before print? That tells the computer this line is INSIDE the if. It's like a secret room!

steps.title: else — the backup plan
steps.text: else means 'if the check is NOT true, do THIS instead'. Now the computer always says something!

steps.title: The treasure game
steps.text: Change score to different numbers and press Run — see when you win and when you don't!

mission.brief: Make an if that prints 'win' when score is 10.

title: Loops
intro: Today the computer learns to do things AGAIN AND AGAIN — like magic!

steps.title: Remember if and else?
steps.text: Last week you taught the computer to CHOOSE! Press Run and remember!

steps.title: Now — LOOPS!
steps.text: Amazing! Today you teach the computer to REPEAT things. This is called a LOOP!

steps.title: What is a loop?
steps.text: A loop does the same thing many times. Like walking in circles, or clapping your hands 5 times!

steps.title: for ... in range(5)
steps.text: This magic line says: 'do the stuff inside 5 times!' The inside must be indented (4 spaces) like with if.
steps.funFact: range(5) makes the numbers 0, 1, 2, 3, 4 — that's 5 numbers total!

steps.title: A unicorn parade!
steps.text: Change the number in range to any amount you like!
steps.pre:
for i in range(6):
    print("🦄 Unicorn!")

steps.title: Use the counter
steps.text: The letter i (or whatever you call it) is the counter — it changes each time through the loop!
steps.pre:
for n in range(5):
    print("Number:", n)

steps.title: Count down and blast off!
steps.text: range(5, 0, -1) means count from 5 down to 1!

mission.brief: Print the word 'yay' three times with a loop.

title: Lists
intro: Today you learn LISTS — a magic box that holds LOTS of things in a line!

steps.title: Remember loops?
steps.text: Last week you made LOOPS! Press Run and watch the stars appear!

steps.title: Now — LISTS!
steps.text: Wow! Today you learn LISTS — a BIG box that holds many things in order!

steps.title: What is a list?
steps.text: A list is one box with lots of things inside, in a line. Like a line of toys on a shelf!

steps.title: Making a list
steps.text: Use SQUARE brackets [ ] and put things inside, separated by commas.

steps.title: Get ONE thing with its spot number
steps.text: pets[0] gets the FIRST one. Why 0? Because computers count starting from 0!
steps.visual:
pets[0] → cat
pets[1] → dog
pets[2] → unicorn
steps.funFact: In the computer world, FIRST is 0! It feels strange at first but you'll get used to it. 🙂

steps.title: Try spot 1 and 2!
steps.text: Change the number in the brackets to 1 or 2 and press Run!

steps.title: Loop through the whole list
steps.text: Combine lists with loops — go through each thing in order!

mission.brief: Make a list of 3 animals and print the first one.

title: Chat with Pixi
intro: Today the computer ASKS YOU questions — real chat with Pixi!

steps.title: Remember lists?
steps.text: Last week you made LISTS! Remember your pet shop? Press Run!

steps.title: Now — the computer asks YOU!
steps.text: Fantastic! Today the computer asks YOU questions — and waits for your answer!

steps.title: What is input()?
steps.text: input() shows a question and waits for you to type an answer. Then it remembers what you typed!
steps.visual:
You: name? 🤔
You type: Ava
Computer: remembers "Ava"

steps.title: Ask and remember
steps.text: Save the answer in a box, then use it! A little pop-up will appear for you to type in.
steps.pre:
name = input("What's your name? ")
print("Hello,", name)

steps.title: Make Pixi react to your answer
steps.text: Ask about a favourite thing — Pixi will reply!
steps.pre:
color = input("Favourite colour? ")
print("I love", color, "too!")

steps.title: A mini chat program
steps.text: Ask two questions and put the answers together!
steps.pre:
name = input("Name? ")
food = input("Favourite food? ")
print(name, "loves", food, "! 🍕")

mission.brief: Use input() to ask a name, then print a greeting.

title: Magic Words
intro: Today YOU teach the computer a brand new magic word — made by you!

steps.title: Remember input()?
steps.text: Last week Pixi ASKED you questions with input! Remember?

steps.title: Now — invent YOUR OWN magic word!
steps.text: Perfect! Today you teach the computer a BRAND NEW magic word — one that YOU invent!

steps.title: What is a function?
steps.text: A function is YOUR OWN magic word. You teach the computer what it does ONCE, then use it as many times as you like!
steps.visual:
def say_hi():         ← teach the word
    print("Hi there!")

say_hi()              ← use it!
say_hi()              ← use it again!

steps.title: Teach your first magic word
steps.text: def means 'DEFINE this new word'. Everything inside (4 spaces!) is what the word does.
steps.pre:
def say_hi():
    print("Hi there! 👋")

say_hi()
say_hi()
steps.funFact: You just wrote your first REAL program — the kind big kid programmers write!

steps.title: Give your magic word an input
steps.text: Put a word inside the ( ) when you teach it — then use that word inside!
steps.pre:
def greet(who):
    print("Hello " + who + "!")

greet("Ava")
greet("Pixi")
greet("Mom")

steps.title: Your own superpower!
steps.text: Make a magic word that gives someone a superpower!
steps.pre:
def superpower(hero, power):
    print(hero, "can", power, "✨")

superpower("Dragon", "fly")
superpower("Pixi", "code")

mission.brief: Write a def and call it twice!

title: Bigger Maths
intro: Today Pixi learns some new MATH TRICKS to make numbers behave!

steps.title: Remember functions?
steps.text: Last week you made your OWN magic words with def! Press Run and see one again.

steps.title: Now — maths superpowers!
steps.text: Today you learn four magic words that do maths tricks for you!

steps.title: round() tidies up decimals
steps.text: round() rounds a messy decimal to a tidy whole number!

steps.title: abs() — always a positive hug
steps.text: abs() makes any number positive. -5 becomes 5. 5 stays 5.
steps.funFact: abs means ABSOLUTE value — the DISTANCE from zero!

steps.title: max() and min() — biggest and smallest
steps.text: Give max() some numbers, it picks the biggest. min() picks the smallest!

steps.title: The high-score game
steps.text: Pick the WINNER of three scores!
steps.pre:
ava = 85
sam = 92
pixi = 78
print("Winner scored:", max(ava, sam, pixi))

mission.brief: Print the biggest of your three favourite numbers!
mission.starter:
a = ___
b = ___
c = ___
print(max(a, b, c))

title: Super Lists
intro: You know lists. Today you learn COOL LIST TRICKS!

steps.title: Remember lists?
steps.text: Last time you made a pet list! Here it is again.

steps.title: Now — list superpowers!
steps.text: Today you unlock three NEW tricks lists can do!

steps.title: len() counts your list
steps.text: len() tells you HOW MANY things are in the list.

steps.title: [-1] gets the LAST one!
steps.text: Negative numbers count from the END. -1 is the last, -2 is second-last!

steps.title: random.choice picks a surprise!
steps.text: random.choice picks ONE from the list — surprise each time!

title: Magic Dice & Random
intro: Make the computer SURPRISE you! Dice, magic 8-balls, silly stories!

steps.title: Remember random.choice?
steps.text: Last week you picked random things from a list!

steps.title: Now — build magic surprises!
steps.text: Today you make dice, magic 8-balls, and silly story generators!

steps.title: A 6-sided dice
steps.text: Dice numbers are 1 to 6 — just make a list!
steps.funFact: Real dice have DOTS, but numbers work the same!

steps.title: Magic 8-ball
steps.text: Ask a yes-or-no question, Pixi picks an answer!

steps.title: Random animal story
steps.text: Pick a random animal AND a random action!

steps.title: A friend picker
steps.text: Who should Pixi hang out with today?
steps.pre:
friends = ["Ava", "Sam", "Max", "Lily"]
print("Friend of the day:", random.choice(friends))

mission.brief: Make a magic 8-ball with 3 answers. Print the answer!

title: While Loops
intro: A new kind of loop that keeps going UNTIL something happens!

steps.title: Remember for loops?
steps.text: for repeats a known number of times. Press Run!

steps.title: Now — while loops!
steps.text: while loops keep going as long as something is TRUE. Different from for!

steps.title: The while shape
steps.text: while [check]: — do the inside WHILE the check is TRUE. Watch!
steps.pre:
x = 0
while x < 3:
    print("going!", x)
    x = x + 1
steps.visual:
x starts 0 → print, x=1
x=1 → print, x=2
x=2 → print, x=3
x=3 → STOP (not < 3)

steps.title: Count up to 5
steps.text: Start at 1, count up, stop when past 5.
steps.pre:
n = 1
while n <= 5:
    print(n)
    n = n + 1

steps.title: Count down to blast off
steps.text: Start high, count down, stop at 0.
steps.pre:
n = 5
while n > 0:
    print(n)
    n = n - 1
print("🚀 BLAST OFF!")

steps.title: Keep adding coins
steps.text: Keep adding coins while we have less than 20!
steps.pre:
coins = 0
while coins < 20:
    coins = coins + 5
    print("Coins:", coins)
steps.funFact: If you FORGET to change the variable inside, while loops forever! Pixi will stop you at 10000 times 😅

mission.brief: Use while to count from 1 to 3.
mission.starter:
n = 1
while n <= 3:
    print(n)
    n = n + 1

intro: Combine your powers — put an IF inside a LOOP!

steps.title: Remember if and for?
steps.text: You know both! Today you COMBINE them.

steps.title: Now — put them TOGETHER
steps.text: Loops that make DECISIONS on each thing. That's real power!

steps.title: if inside for
steps.text: Loop through numbers. Print only the BIG ones!
steps.visual:
3 → skip (too small)
10 → BIG!
7 → BIG!
2 → skip
8 → BIG!

steps.title: Count the matches
steps.text: Count how MANY scores are over 5!

steps.title: Only the cats!
steps.text: Loop through pets, print only the cats!

title: Make a Mini-Game
intro: Today you build a real game using EVERYTHING you know!

steps.title: You know SO MUCH now!
steps.text: print, variables, if, loops, lists, functions, random. Let's build!

steps.title: Game 1 — Lucky dice
steps.text: Roll a dice. Win if you get more than 3!
steps.pre:
import random
roll = random.choice([1,2,3,4,5,6])
print("🎲 You rolled:", roll)
if roll > 3:
    print("🏆 You win!")
else:
    print("😔 Try again!")

steps.title: Game 2 — Pixi picks a treasure
steps.text: Pixi picks a random treasure for you!
steps.pre:
treasures = ["🏆 trophy", "💎 gem", "🎁 gift", "⭐ star", "🪙 coin"]
print("Pixi found:", random.choice(treasures))

steps.title: Game 3 — Three-strike counter
steps.text: Three tries. Count strikes!
steps.pre:
strikes = 0
while strikes < 3:
    strikes = strikes + 1
    print("Strike", strikes, "!")
print("⚾ You're out!")

steps.title: Make it YOURS
steps.text: Change the emojis, words, numbers to your own!
steps.pre:
game_name = "My Game"
prizes = ["candy", "sticker", "nothing"]
print("🎮", game_name)
print("You won:", random.choice(prizes))

mission.brief: Make a dice game that says WIN if the roll is 6, else TRY AGAIN.

steps.text: Loops can print things in a pattern!

steps.title: Now — DRAW with code!

title: Your First AI!
intro: TODAY YOU MAKE A REAL AI! It thinks with rules and surprises!

steps.title: Look how far you've come!
steps.text: You know: print, variables, if, loops, lists, def, random. That's EVERYTHING you need for a tiny AI!

steps.title: AI = rules + guesses
steps.text: AI is a computer that looks at things and DECIDES. Simple ones use if/else!
steps.visual:
You: "What should I wear?"
AI thinks: if hot → shorts
           if cold → coat

steps.title: The weather bot
steps.text: An AI weather helper!

steps.title: A random compliment bot
steps.text: AI that picks a NICE thing to say!
steps.pre:
compliments = ["You're smart! 🤓", "You're kind! 💖", "You're funny! 😄", "You're cool! 😎"]
print("Pixi says:", random.choice(compliments))

steps.text: An AI that cheers you up!

steps.text: Pixi predicts your future!
steps.pre:
futures = ["🏆 You will win today!", "🍀 Luck comes your way!", "⭐ A star day!", "🎁 A surprise!"]

title: Named Treasure Chests
intro: A dictionary is like a treasure chest with labels. Each label (a "key") opens one thing inside!

steps.title: Remember Your First AI!
steps.text: Last week we built a mood bot that chose a smiley from a list. Today our AI gets a MEMORY. 🧠
steps.funFact: Real AI assistants like me also remember stuff about you in little labelled chests!

steps.title: Today — Named Treasure Chests!
steps.text: A dictionary looks like this: { "label": value }. Each label is a word in quotes and opens ONE thing inside the chest.

steps.title: Build Pixi's chest
steps.text: We use curly braces { } and put LABEL : VALUE inside. Try: pixi = { "name": "Pixi", "mood": "happy" }
steps.funFact: The label is called a KEY. The thing inside is called a VALUE. Key opens → value appears!

steps.title: Open one label
steps.text: Use SQUARE brackets to open a label: pixi["name"] brings out just the name!

steps.title: Change what's inside
steps.text: Put something new in a label: pixi["mood"] = "sleepy" 💤
steps.funFact: You can keep changing it — like a magic box that rewrites itself!

steps.title: Mission — Make YOUR Pixi card
steps.text: Build a chest with 3 labels: name, age and favourite. Then print each one. 🎴

mission.brief: Make a dictionary about YOU with 3 labels and print each one.

title: Teach by Example
intro: Real AI learns by looking at LOTS of examples. Today we teach the computer to spot a pattern from a list of examples!

steps.title: Remember Named Chests?
steps.text: Last week each chest had labels. Today each EXAMPLE has labels — same idea, but LOTS of them!

steps.title: Today — Teach by Example!
steps.text: When you show a kid lots of cats, they learn "cat". AI does the same. We give it a LIST of examples and it counts a pattern.

steps.title: Counting cats
steps.text: Use a for loop and a counter. Every time we see "cat", we add 1.
steps.funFact: This is the SAME idea real AI uses to recognise things — count patterns!

steps.title: Count HAPPY words
steps.text: Give me a list of moods. Count how many are "happy".

steps.title: Is-it-a-cat bot
steps.text: Write a function that returns True if the word is "cat", False if not. That's a little CLASSIFIER!
steps.funFact: Return sends an answer BACK out of the function. 📬

steps.title: Mission — Smart counter bot
steps.text: Count how many 👍 are in this list of reactions.

mission.brief: Count how many "pizza" are in a list of foods.

title: The Guessing AI
intro: Today our AI reads what you type and guesses the mood! This is called a keyword classifier. 🕵️

steps.title: Remember counting cats?
steps.text: Last week we counted a pattern. Today we LOOK FOR one — and the AI guesses what you mean.

steps.title: Today — Word hunting!
steps.text: in is a tiny magic word. "happy" in "I feel happy" asks: is that word in there? True or False!

steps.title: Try it
steps.text: Type a sentence and look for a word with in.
steps.pre:
sentence = "I am very happy today"
print("happy" in sentence)
print("sad" in sentence)

steps.title: Guess the mood
steps.text: Our AI checks for happy / sad / angry and replies. If-elif-else lets it try more than two things!
steps.funFact: elif means "else if" — a middle check between if and else.

steps.title: Ask the kid
steps.text: Use input() so YOU type the sentence and the AI replies.

steps.title: Mission — The food AI
steps.text: Make an AI that guesses the food you want from one word.

mission.brief: Build a feelings AI. Ask the user how they feel. If it contains "happy" print 😊, if "sad" print 🤗, else 🤔.

title: Your Own AI Friend 🎓
intro: You know print, variables, maths, strings, if/else, loops, lists, input, functions, random AND dictionaries. Today we build your own AI friend! 🎉

steps.title: Look how far you've come!
steps.text: 20 weeks ago you only knew print(). Now you can build an AI friend. 🤯 Ready for the big one?
steps.visual: print 🎤 + if 🧠 + for 🔁 + input 💬 + random 🎲 = AI FRIEND 🤖

steps.title: Our AI Friend — the plan
steps.text: We'll give our friend: a name (variable), a list of jokes, a mood checker (if/else), and a random surprise. Mix everything you learned!

steps.title: Part 1 — meet and greet
steps.text: The friend asks your name and says hi.
steps.pre:
name = input("What's your name? ")
print("Hi,", name + "! I'm Pixi 🤖")

steps.title: Part 2 — tell a random joke
steps.text: Use a list and random.choice to pick one.
steps.pre:
jokes = [
  "Why did the computer sneeze? It had a virus!",
  "Why do robots love beaches? Sand-wiches!",
  "What's a robot's favourite snack? Micro-chips!",
]
print("Joke time! 🎤")
print(random.choice(jokes))

steps.title: Part 3 — mood check
steps.text: Ask how the user feels and reply based on their words.

steps.title: Part 4 — random fortune
steps.text: End the chat with a surprise fortune.
steps.pre:
fortunes = ["⭐ Today is your day!","🎉 A fun surprise is coming!","🌈 Big smiles ahead!","🍀 Lucky day!"]
print("Your fortune:", random.choice(fortunes))

steps.title: Mission — Put it ALL together
steps.text: Smoosh all 4 parts into ONE program. This is your very own AI! 🏆
steps.pre:
name = input("Name? ")
print("Hi,", name + "! I'm Pixi 🤖")

jokes = ["Why did the computer sneeze? Virus!","Micro-chips are robots' snacks!"]
print(random.choice(jokes))

mood = input("How do you feel? ")
if "happy" in mood or "good" in mood:
    print("😊 Yay!")
elif "sad" in mood:
    print("🤗 Hug!")
else:
    print("🤔 Tell me more!")

fortunes = ["⭐ Great day!","🎉 Surprise coming!","🌈 Smiles ahead!"]
print(random.choice(fortunes))
print("Bye, " + name + "! 👋")
steps.funFact: You just built a chatbot. Real ones do the same thing — just with BIGGER lists and smarter patterns. 🧠

mission.brief: Build YOUR AI friend! Name, joke, mood check, and a fortune — all in one program.
mission.starter:
name = input("Name? ")
print("Hi " + name + "!")

jokes = ["joke 1", "joke 2"]
print(random.choice(jokes))

mood = input("How are you? ")
if "happy" in mood:
    print("😊")
else:
    print("🤗")

print("Have a great day, " + name + "!")
